Gamma-ratio asymptotics give |u_n| asymptotic |z|^n n^(Re(1/z)−1), with special terminating and z=0 cases handled directly. Thus square summability is exact in the disk and on the specified open boundary arc; orthogonal diagonals yield infinite geometric multiplicity. Independent finite checker verifies sample recurrences but is not proof.
